sentences.en: I would like to book an appointment.
Is the doctor available tomorrow?
What time should I arrive?
sentences.ar: في أي وقت ينبغي أن أحضر؟

sentences.en: Please bring your identification.
I have an appointment at ten.
Where is the reception desk?
I need to update my details.
Could you confirm my appointment?
Please take a seat in the waiting area.
The doctor will see you shortly.
What brings you here today?
I have not been feeling well.
When did the symptoms begin?
They started two days ago.
Does anything make it worse?
It gets worse in the evening.
Do you have any allergies?
I am not sure about that.
Are you taking any medication?
Here is a list of my medications.
The doctor asked a few questions.
I need to describe the pain clearly.
It feels better when I rest.
Do I need any tests?
The nurse will explain the next step.
How long will the results take?
You can view the results online.
sentences.ar: يمكنك الاطلاع على النتائج عبر الإنترنت.

sentences.en: Could you explain that again?
sentences.ar: هل يمكنك شرح ذلك مرة أخرى؟

sentences.en: I want to understand the instructions.
Should I schedule a follow-up visit?
sentences.ar: هل ينبغي أن أحجز موعد متابعة؟

sentences.en: Please contact the clinic if needed.
sentences.ar: يرجى التواصل مع العيادة عند الحاجة.

sentences.en: Thank you for answering my questions.
I will follow the doctor's advice.
I hope to feel better soon.

sections.heading: A new situation
paragraphs: Dina was learning how to handle at the clinic in everyday English. The goal was to communicate clearly and politely. Dina practiced “I would like to book an appointment.” A useful phrase was “Is the doctor available tomorrow?” A useful phrase was “What time should I arrive?” They repeated it to remember the meaning.
